_readme: Registry of published-etext sources used for reference-based OCR scoring (#3212).
Each language has a works file in scripts/eval/reference-works/<key>.json holding
short curated passages (reference text inline, with provenance). Tiers:
api    — passages fetched programmatically (fetch helper noted below)
bulk   — passages extracted from a one-time corpus download
manual — passages hand-pasted from an edition with no clean API; source_url required
We compare against short reference passages; we never re-host reference texts.
Identity NEVER comes from titles — titles are only a cheap candidate prefilter;
the word-level (char-level for cjk) subsequence guard in lib/metrics.mjs decides.

chinese.notes: Original system (build-ctext-groundtruth.mjs). Canonical printed texts only.

hebrew.notes: Sefaria returns structured JSON (he field). Strip niqqud at normalize time.

latin.notes: Fold u/v, i/j, long-s, ae/oe ligatures — edition orthography, not OCR error.

greek.notes: Polytonic diacritics folded at normalize time.

tibetan.notes: Existing hand-built ground truth in ground-truth/ predates this registry.

german.notes: DTA is page-aligned TEI, often the SAME edition we scanned — best-case reference.

armenian.notes: No clean fetch API. CAUTION: hy.wikisource's same-title Buzand is the MODERN translation — a decoy the guard must reject (pinned in tests/unit/reference-ocr-guard.test.ts).
